enderbotanypots.tooltip.enderpot: A small pot for growing many kinds of plants. Automatically places output in the Ender Chest
enderbotanypots.jei.description: Change the frequency of the Pot, by right-click it with an Ender Chest, Ender Tank, Ender Pouch, or another Ender Botany Pot.\n\nAlternatively, hold one of these in your off-hand while placing the Pot to apply its frequency to the placed Pot.
enderbotanypots.chat.not_owner: Cannot change frequency. You are not the owner of this Pot
